items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: I got to give Honore Dutrey -- I'm calling trombone players.

ctx.x: The trombone players, which trombone Players do you remember that you enjoyed working with?

There you are again. Poor me, (unintelligible). So many of them I worked with a lot of good ones and a lot of bad ones. You know. I got to give all -- old Red the devil, which belongs to him. Ory, and I got to give Eddie Atkins, I got to give Honore Dutrey -- I'm calling trombone players. George Fields --
